List-I (Figures
of speech)
List-II (Meanings)
(A) Oxymoron
(I) a word pronounced like another word but with a
different meaning or spelling

(B) Homophone (II) a phrase that combines two words that seem to be the
opposite of each other
(C) Alliteration
(III) an indirect comparison between two things without
using the words - like or as
(D) Metaphor
(IV) the same letter or sound occurring at the beginning
of two or more words in succession
